note.title: A new job title is spreading: Forward Deployed Creative
note.text: Luma, Higgsfield and Magnific are all hiring for it this week, at $110K to $205K. The job: make great work with the company's AI tool in front of its clients, and show them how you did it. If you can make strong work fast and explain your process, that's a real career path now.

jobs.title: AI Video Producer, mid to senior
jobs.summary: Creator-first agency. Strong on all major AI video tools (Higgsfield above all), can edit, uses ElevenLabs. Starts as a one-week gig with repeat work after. Tools and credits are paid for. Apply through the form in the post.

jobs.title: AI-Enabled Creative Director
jobs.summary: Lead creative teams and sell ideas to clients, with AI built into how the work is made. Needs real creative-director experience plus hands-on AI workflows.

jobs.title: Video Editor & AI Content Producer
jobs.summary: The 'As Seen on TV' company behind Pocket Hose. Strong editor who can make realistic AI product demos and believable human performances for TV spots and digital ads.

jobs.title: Video Editor & Producer (AI + performance ads)
jobs.summary: High-volume AI-powered ads for Meta and TikTok, judged on how they sell, not how cinematic they look. Proven AI ad track record required.

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Creative, Filmmaker Expert
jobs.summary: Build tailored demos and proofs of concept for Magnific's enterprise clients using its AI suite. A filmmaker's eye plus client-facing confidence.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Creative (US)
jobs.summary: Luma's creative lead with major brands and agencies: build AI production workflows with them and make high-craft work in Dream Machine as the proof.

jobs.title: Creative Director (Video Ads)
jobs.summary: Own the visual craft of Jerry's video output from concept to final cut at a well-funded pre-IPO startup.

jobs.title: Creative Community Lead
jobs.summary: Lead the creator community around the No. 1 AI clipping tool (20M+ users). For someone known and trusted among video creators.

jobs.title: Creative Technologist
jobs.summary: Build and show AI-native creative workflows with Ideogram's image models. Canada-based, Eastern time zone.

jobs.title: AI Video Creator (UGC-style ads)
jobs.summary: Short vertical ecommerce ads that look real (Veo 3, Kling, HeyGen or similar). DM Patrick Perriel 2 or 3 examples and your per-video rate.

jobs.title: AI Video / Editing / Motion Design
jobs.summary: B2B commercial studio booked out until March. Freelance gigs that grow into full-time roles; they say they pay top dollar. Portfolio at artificial.film.

jobs.title: GenAI Specialist
jobs.summary: Generative AI plus traditional VFX and filmmaking for film and TV content. CV and portfolio to the email in the post, not by DM.

jobs.title: AI Supervisor, Scripted

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Creative

jobs.title: Creative Producer

jobs.title: Editor + Motion Graphics

jobs.title: Motion Designer

jobs.title: Creative

jobs.title: AI Creative Technologist
